references.text: Hannah praises God as the rock; there is none like him – the same theme of God as the only true rock
David confesses that there is no rock except our God, emphasizing God's unique position as the rock
Isaiah declares that there is no other rock but the Lord, making the same theological point about the powerlessness of idols
The Lord declares that there is no other god, reflecting the contrast between Israel's God and the gods of the nations
The psalmist asks who is a rock besides our God, repeating the motif from Deuteronomy 32:31
God alone is my rock and salvation – emphasizing God's unique role as protector and deliverer
Paul identifies Christ as the spiritual rock that followed Israel, linking the rock motif to the Messiah
